Target: a fragment-growth campaign off a phenol hit
This is a tight developability window: there is little room to grow the fragment hit, so the molecule must stay small and balanced.

Required pharmacophore fragment (must appear in the SMILES):
  c1ccccc1   -- the benzene core of the original fragment hit

Property window (the molecule must sit inside all of these):
  molecular weight   150 - 300
  logP               <= 3.4
  H-bond acceptors   1 - 6   (N + O count)
  halogens           <= 1
  heavy atoms        14 - 22

Starting hit to improve on:
  Oc1ccccc1

Aim for a real, developable molecule: keep the pharmacophore, stay inside the
window, and improve the affinity_score over the starting hit. Check any
candidate with:  python3 oracle.py "<SMILES>"
